_comment: Reference copy of the Combat Patrol datasheet schema. NOT loaded — it is not in the roster. Copy it to <unit-id>.json and add the id to the roster in ../index.json. Same schema as a matched-play unit (see ../../units/_TEMPLATE.json) MINUS everything list-building: no points, no costing, no baseModels/maxModels, no wargearChoices/wargearExclusiveChoices, no enhancements. Combat Patrol loadouts are static, so weapons are listed exactly as the models are armed and every weapon needs a real count.
